summary: Tested Brand Memory OS public API and desktop/mobile UI. Core landing, seeded workspace, recommendations, hard-rule blocking, memory save, library, blueprint download, and responsive layout passed. No-evidence briefs incorrectly report supported patterns.

critical.issue: A brief with no matching attributes returns evidence_count=2 (or 3 after outcome update) and performance-backed recommendations instead of a no-evidence empty state. The ranking loop counts every complete campaign as evidence regardless of matched_attributes.

minor.issue: PUT accepts an unvalidated raw dict, unlike the Brief and Outcome Pydantic models; malformed rules can later break recommendation/blueprint logic.

integration_issues.issue: UI displays '3 performance-backed patterns found for this brief' and renders recommendation cards for Astrology / Mars explorers / Moon rocks, violating the non-fabricated empty-state acceptance.

action_items: Change recommendation evidence_count and supported status to count only campaigns with matched attributes; return a useful explicit no-evidence response/state when none match.
Add Pydantic validation for brand rules and handle rules/outcome API errors in the UI.
Replace hardcoded northstar workspace filters with the active workspace identity before claiming workspace isolation.
critical_code_review_comments: Workspace isolation is conceptual only: every endpoint hardcodes workspace_id='northstar', and there is no workspace selection or authorization boundary.
The UI labels the brief as 'Autosaved just now', but no brief autosave API or persistence exists; this is misleading if autosave is an acceptance requirement.
record() always posts campaigns[0] rather than a selected campaign/recommendation and does not catch failures, so the outcome action can update the wrong campaign or leave an unhandled rejection.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (one acceptance defect; all other executable flows passed)

seed_data_creation: No new seed records. API test updated cmp-062 outcome and added TEST_precise/TEST_UI_rule memory values in the shared demo workspace.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing -> workspace -> recommendations, prohibited-claim block, memory add/save, library, export, and mobile layout were exercised. Re-run no-evidence API/UI after ranking fix; reset or account for the test-created rule/outcome values.
rca of the issue: In server.py recommendations(), matched is computed correctly, but every campaign is appended with status supported when outcome.status is complete and evidence_count sums all supported records. The response/UI therefore treats unrelated complete campaigns as evidence. Filter supported evidence by matched attributes (and define an honest closest-pattern display separately), then expose an empty state when evidence_count is zero.
